# Lasso — mean vs. median final-iterate loss

Metric: `f(x^K) - f(x^\star)` at the final iterate, per problem instance, aggregated over the test / OOD batches.
Training sample N = 1000. Each K uses that K's own best learned schedule (same source as the `losses` paper plot). Medians are for comparison only — no plots are produced.
